newsitem.title: USA: IMC Global enters food-quality salt business.
newsitem.headline: IMC Global enters food-quality salt business.

text.p: IMC Global Inc said Friday its potash business unit, IMC Kalium, has begun producing food-quality salt at the company's Hersey, Michigan facility.
The operation, with an annual capacity of 415,000 tons, is expected to produce 300,000 tons of high-quality salt during its first year. Shipments to customers began this week, the company said.
Food-quality salt is a new business line for the company, which produces and markets phosphate and potash crop nutrients and animal feed ingredients.
The operation is designed to eventually produce 600,000 tons annually and the Hersey site has can be expanded to 1.2 million tons, the company said.
IMC Global shares were down 1/16 at 33-5/16 Friday.
